hero.title: Charles David Lopez
hero.description:
I built this portfolio not to impress, but to, in a way, satisfy my need for expression and my drive for passion. I refuse to participate in the performativistic acts that most software developers are trapped in.

This is my very first passion project, built at the earliest stage of my career, made to simplify my life when tracking my work and to showcase my skills in a way that is authentic to me.

profile.title: Problem Solver. Digital Generalist.
profile.name: Charles David
bio: I'm an aspiring software engineer who enjoys turning ideas into clean, accessible websites. I build projects that are easy to navigate, easy to maintain, and easy to update.
My current focus is on front-end development, simple UI interactions, and organizing my portfolio using a structure that scales well as I add more work.
goals: Launch more portfolio projects with clear case studies.
Master front-end tooling and performance best practices.
Collaborate on projects that combine design with strong engineering.
